title: The Star Zoo
steps: The menagerie deck: open Maintenance chart
Tool rack: look at Maintenance chart
Tool rack: Switch panel → solve "Switch panel" (answer: 10011101)
Tool rack: Grabber → get Grabber
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Portholes
Portholes: look at View
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Planter
Planter: use Grabber on Glowing fruit → get Glowing fruit
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Terrarium
Terrarium: use Glowing fruit on Jelly creature
Terrarium: Energy cell → get Energy cell
Terrarium: look at Jelly creature
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Robot
Robot: use Energy cell on Robot
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Navigation console
Navigation console: look at Robot
Navigation console: Planet buttons → solve "Navigation console" (answer: 🌍 ☄️ 🌕 🪐)
Navigation console: Drawer → get Right card half
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Cargo crate
Cargo crate: Colour lock → solve "Colour lock" (answer: #f0c93a #e2483d #3f74e0 #4fc25a)
Cargo crate: Crate → get Left card half, Ship's logbook
Go back to The menagerie deck
The menagerie deck: open Airlock
Combine Right card half with Left card half → get Key card
Airlock: use Key card on Card slot
Airlock: Keypad → solve "Docking code" (answer: 7194)
Airlock: Step outside
